description: This file defines React components wrapping radix-ui Popover primitives to provide a customizable popover UI component, including trigger, content, and anchor components.

methods.name: Popover
methods.description: A React component that renders a radix-ui Popover Root with passed props.

methods.name: PopoverTrigger
methods.description: A React component that renders a radix-ui Popover Trigger with passed props.

methods.name: PopoverContent
methods.description: A React component that renders the content of the popover with styling and animation classes.

methods.name: PopoverAnchor
methods.description: A React component that renders the popover anchor element.
